Rotating example credentials

When an example key may be exposed, rotate it and review what it was used for. Long lines in the source are wrapped.

Topics
  • Other page

Identify the key

To find the key owner

  1. Open the console.

  2. Search for the key ID.

    example-cli list-keys --user alice
Warning

Deleting a key in use stops the workload that uses it.

Key fields

keyId

The identifier of the key.

status

Either Active or Inactive.

  • Inactive keys cannot sign requests.

Key states

StateMeaning
ActiveCan sign requests
